{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.16

|gr1= Curator

|descr= Returns list of all curator selected items.

|s1= [[curatorSelected]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [objects, groups, waypoints, markers]
* objects: [[Array]] of [[Object]]s
* groups: [[Array]] of [[Group]]s
* waypoints: [[Waypoint]]
* markers: [[Array]] of [[String]]s

|x1= <sqf>_selectedItems = curatorSelected;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>curatorSelected params ["_selObjects", "_selGroups", "_selWaypoints", "_selMarkers"];</sqf>

|seealso= [[curatorMouseOver]] [[setCuratorSelected]] [[addCuratorSelected]] [[Arma 3: Curator]]
